profile_text.body:
Relevance AI is a company whose website presents it as a provider of specialist AI agents for business tasks. The site says the platform is used to build agents for sales, customer success, marketing and HR, and that customers can run millions of daily tasks on one platform. It frames the offering around delivering maximum ROI through optimized specialist agents, and quotes Rob Giglio saying the company is looking for every place where AI can allow sellers and customer success representatives to be more engaged with customers.

The product tracked under the Relevance AI name is described as a no-code AI workforce with agent teams and task automation, and with APAC data residency. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
